title: A general as sole defender protects when the recapture is legal
rationale: mx-chs-009 with the white king moved c1 to d1, the single change. The kings no longer share a file, so c7c6 is a legal recapture and the cannon is protected on c6: Red's e5e6 is not a chase, the chase is not sustained across every Red move, and the repetition is neutral and merely claimable.
